description: This file defines the TopDownFormatter class responsible for layout and rendering of document elements from top to bottom in a PDF document, within the MigraDoc library. It manages positioning, pagination, layout calculations, and rendering logic for document elements, handling page breaks and area management.

classes.name: TopDownFormatter
classes.description: Responsible for laying out and rendering document elements vertically from top to bottom within determined page areas, including handling pagination, area management, and element placement logic.

methods.name: MarginMax
methods.description: Calculates the maximum margin or sum of margins based on their positivity, used to determine vertical spacing.

methods.name: FormatOnAreas
methods.description: Main method to iterate over document elements, positioning and rendering them within available areas, handling page breaks, and managing rendering states.

methods.name: FinishPage
methods.description: Finalizes rendering for a page, storing render information and determining the last render info for continuity.

methods.name: IsForcedAreaBreak
methods.description: Determines if an area break should be forcibly inserted before a given element based on layout rules.

methods.name: PreviousRendererNeedsRemoveEnding
methods.description: Checks if the ending info of a previous renderer needs to be removed before rendering the next element.

methods.name: NextElementsDoNotFit
methods.description: Predicts whether subsequent elements can fit into remaining area considering layout constraints and margins.

methods.name: NeedsEndingOnNextArea
methods.description: Decides if an element's ending info should be deferred to the next area based on layout rules and pagination.
